name: feature-definition-planner
description: Synthesize a feature-brief text output from intake, landscape, and options artifacts. Preserves original user intent. One-shot; planning only.

inputs.name: feature-idea
inputs.description: Original feature idea text or path reference.

inputs.name: landscape-report
inputs.description: Landscape research report; may be empty when research skipped.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: feature-brief
outputs.description: Primary handoff markdown text; not a required file.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Non-blocking follow-ups only; empty when none.
